summary: SK Telecom Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution on July 23, 2026 to designate August 31, 2026 as the record date for a quarterly cash dividend of KRW 830 per common share, with a total payment of approximately KRW 176.84 billion and a market dividend rate of 0.9%. The dividend is scheduled for payment on September 17, 2026. This is a routine quarterly dividend declaration by the issuer, made pursuant to its articles of incorporation and applicable Korean capital markets law. No special situation event is involved; this filing constitutes standard dividend disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
